Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

sooty 0.7.0

  • The catalogue works again. The Pawsey buckets it listed (and the bucket that held the catalogue itself) are no longer public, so every source failed. Each dataset now points at where its files are public today: the aad-derived bucket on Pawsey, Source Cooperative, or the publisher (NOAA, Copernicus Marine, University of Bremen, Remote Sensing Systems). Dataset identifiers and the columns of sooty_files() are unchanged.

  • These datasets are current again and are extended as their publishers add files: ghrsst-tif, oisst-avhrr-v02r01, SEALEVEL_GLO_PHY_L4, NSIDC_SEAICE_PS_N25km, NSIDC_SEAICE_PS_S25km, antarctica-amsr2-asi-s3125-tif, BREMEN-SEAICE-SMOS-north, ccmp-wind-product-v2, and the monthly and 5day esacci-oc-l3s-chlor-a-merged-*. The others are an archive that ends in 2025 (oisst-tif, the sealevel-*-tif family, daily and annual esacci-oc-l3s-chlor-a-merged-*). See the README for where to go next.

  • Fixed sealevel-sla-tif, sealevel-ugos-tif, sealevel-ugosa-tif, sealevel-vgos-tif and sealevel-vgosa-tif, which listed the files of the error variables (err_sla, err_ugosa, err_vgosa) instead of their own.

  • SEALEVEL_GLO_PHY_L4 is now the 0.125 degree product throughout (reprocessed, then near real time). It was 0.25 degree before 2024-11-20.

  • NSIDC_SEAICE_PS_N25km and NSIDC_SEAICE_PS_S25km now list a different product on the same grids: the NOAA/NSIDC climate data record of sea ice concentration (G02202 version 6, variable cdr_seaice_conc, a fraction from 0 to 1), daily from 1978-10-25, read from NSIDC. They listed NSIDC-0051 and NSIDC-0081, which NSIDC serves only to a login. G02202 has a file for every day; the days whose file holds no concentration are left out (the longest run is 1987-12-03 to 1988-01-13), so a date in the list is a date with data (#3).

  • A failed update of the catalogue no longer removes the local cache (which made the first sooty_files() of a session fail). The cache is replaced only by a download that reads as the catalogue, a cache older than the catalogue bundled with the package is replaced by it, and the updated catalogue now comes from a release of the sooty repository.

  • The catalogue is built by data-raw/build-catalogue.R, from anonymous listings of the public stores.

sooty 0.6.12026-03-10

  • Sooty cache is now never installed into user space during any examples / document / test / build / install / check processes, thanks to CRAN.

sooty 0.6.02026-03-03

  • A file cache is now stored internally in the package, installed to user cache space as a file, and this is checked for staleness once per session and updated if internet access is available.

  • Status of user cache can be checked with new function sooty_cache_info() which returns information about the location, age, and size of the cache.

  • The the non-curated catalogue is no longer exposed to exported functions.

sooty 0.5.02025-05-22

  • dataset() is now deprecated in favour of datasource()

  • Created standalone function available_datasets(), and removed @curated, @available_datasets from the datasource object.

  • Now using more robust model of GDAL protocol and absolute URLs.

  • Added an S7 object to set dataset id and retrieve files.

  • Removed all read functionality.

  • Removed memoization.

  • Fix scaling mistake for AMSR ice.

  • Added 3.125km AMSR ice.

sooty 0.1.02024-12-06

  • Initial CRAN version.

  • Renamed package.
